interpretation: Rates use only valid, same-dataset, same-scorer-version, same-mode paired cases with a common metric or determinate check. Scorer corrections require both immutable observations to be rescored separately under one version before a production comparison. Every observed metric regression is listed; confidence intervals describe uncertainty and do not erase hard failures. Operational aggregates use only matched observations with known values in both runs.
